job.job_title: AI Engineer GenAI Platform & AI Products
job.job_description:
Role: AI Engineer GenAI Platform & AI Products

Overview

Join a high-impact AI team building next-generation, GenAI-powered product experiences and a scalable AI platform that enables them. This role focuses on developing intelligent systems such as conversational agents, personalization engines, and agentic workflows, while contributing to a robust AI infrastructure that ensures reliability, scalability, and production readiness.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and deploy production-grade AI solutions, including:
Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines
LLM-powered recommendations and personalization
Conversational AI agents
Agentic workflow automation
Develop and enhance the shared AI platform:
Retrieval and vector search infrastructure
Evaluation frameworks and quality benchmarks
Model monitoring, guardrails, and observability
Build LLM-based applications and integrations across:
Marketing automation platforms
Business intelligence tools
Customer-facing applications
Continuously improve model performance by:
Running structured evaluation frameworks
Optimizing prompts, retrieval strategies, and model selection
Leverage AI-driven development tools to accelerate delivery and maintain code quality
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align GenAI capabilities with personalization and business needs
Document system design decisions, evaluation results, and best practices

Required Skills

Strong proficiency in Python with experience building production-level AI/LLM applications
Hands-on experience in at least one of the following areas:
RAG systems and retrieval architectures
LLM evaluation frameworks
Agent-based frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, or equivalent)
LLM-powered workflow automation
Solid understanding of:
Prompt engineering techniques
Context window management
Trade-offs in LLM output quality
Experience with:
Vector databases
Embedding models
Semantic search technologies

Nice to Have

Experience with high-scale consumer or digital product environments
Exposure to MLOps, model deployment, and lifecycle management
Experience working in globally distributed teams

Why Join

Work on cutting-edge GenAI use cases with real-world impact
Build scalable AI systems used across multiple business functions
Collaborate with a forward-thinking, globally distributed AI team
